body: Jordan, 15 Oct 2026: "Is there also an MCP where Claude can connect to Tether to control my other Macs?" Then: "I want this. It would be an entirely separate tool, right it would be tether CLI/API/MCP", "Basically, the MCP would allow you to use Tether to connect to anyone of your devices on the Tailscale network" and "D-A: new repo mcp-tether for the MCP server and the tether command. Write the plans."
